ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict variant effects on gene regulation and expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair pretrained DNA sequence models with variant and chromatin data to score noncoding and rare variant effects.

ranked.headline: Computational methods target specific error sources in RNA-seq and spatial profiling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published tools address noise, ambiguity, and resolution limits in single-cell and spatial RNA sequencing analyses.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning models predict protein interactions and binding effects
ranked.summary: ESM and ProtBERT embeddings now feed sequence-only models for interaction, binding affinity, HLA binding, and allergenicity prediction.

ranked.headline: Inferring state-dependent noise and governing dynamics from sparse single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell methods increasingly model state transitions from noisy, scarce, and unpaired data, separating intrinsic noise from deterministic structure.

ranked.headline: Generative models design CDR loops, peptides and ligands conditioned on 3D structure
ranked.summary: ConformAb and EPO extend structure-conditioned generators toward conformation-aware antibody design and energy-aware ensemble sampling.

ranked.headline: GPU and SIMD acceleration of sequence alignment, simulation, and database searches
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe faster alignment, read simulation, and sequence search tools for large microbial and genomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Fusing protein sequence, structure and chemical embeddings into shared learned spaces
ranked.summary: November 2025 preprints and publications fuse protein language-model embeddings with structural, chemical, or homolog-retrieval information.

ranked.headline: Graph-based deep learning predicts molecular interactions, activities and cancer targets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair graph architectures with explicit interpretability, benchmarking and activity-cliff analysis for molecular endpoints.

ranked.headline: Reference genomes and long-read variant calling benchmarked against established truth sets
ranked.summary: Gapless T2T assemblies and population-scale multiomic cohorts now set benchmarks for long-read genome and variant accuracy.

ranked.headline: Generative models steered by objectives for peptide and small-molecule design
ranked.summary: Generative models for peptides and small molecules are increasingly conditioned on target, binding, and property objectives to yield testable candidates.

ranked.headline: Viscous-to-elastic shifts drive condensate aging; α1-antitrypsin droplets harden
ranked.summary: Viscoelastic modeling and molecular dynamics now link condensate aging, membrane leaflet fluidity, and α1-antitrypsin phase separation to material state.

ranked.headline: Machine learning predicts carbapenemase and resistance evolution from bacterial data
ranked.summary: Disk diffusion data and genome-level models are now being used to predict carbapenemase production and simulate resistance evolution.

ranked.headline: Fusing chemical structure with transcriptomic dose-response data to predict toxicity
ranked.summary: Joint structural, transcriptomic, and pharmacokinetic inputs are now being combined to predict toxicity endpoints in interpretable models.

ranked.headline: Genome-resolved metagenomics links gut microbiome shifts to lifestyle transition
ranked.summary: Assembly-based genome recovery now pairs with clinical, mobility and surveillance data to trace resistance carriage and pathogen epidemiology.

ranked.headline: Calibration-free counting and learned classifiers across imaging and nanopore data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test calibration-free and learned analysis strategies for DNA-PAINT, nanopore, and intracellular viscosity measurements.

ranked.headline: Sequence determinants of chromatin structure, accessibility and 3D genome organization
ranked.summary: Multiscale simulation and sequence-to-profile models now connect linker DNA, low-affinity motifs and AT-rich sequence to chromatin states.

ranked.headline: Population-scale pear genomes, spruce SNP arrays and methylation inheritance in hybrids
ranked.summary: Population-scale pear genomes, a cross-species spruce SNP array and phased Vitis methylomes now resolve history and inheritance.

ranked.headline: Single-cell measurements constrain kinetic and dynamical models of gene expression
ranked.summary: ChronoSeq's ~7-minute scRNA-seq resolution now lets dynamical models be fit directly to observed single-cell response trajectories.

ranked.headline: Multimodal models fuse histology, genomics, and spatial omics for biomedical prediction
ranked.summary: Learned fusion of histology, transcriptomics, and multi-omics now spans survival analysis, foundation models, and cross-modality translation.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for model building, validation, and single-cell analysis expand…
ranked.summary: Interoperable, validated, and FAIR-oriented software now couples SBML/PEtab models, hybrid ML, and single-cell workflows into shareable environments.

ranked.headline: Input selection and data-efficient training reshape histology and omics prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work tests how tiling, modality selection and simulated sample size govern accuracy of biomedical models trained on limited data.

ranked.headline: Molecular Dynamics Maps Lipid Transport Routes in SERINC3, LNP Fusion and ATG2A
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and simulation studies now resolve lipid translocation pathways across distinct membrane transport systems.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for mass spectrometry metadata, annotation, and imaging reliability
ranked.summary: Individual processing steps in mass spectrometry and imaging workflows are now receiving explicit standardization, benchmarking, or consensus-based checks.

ranked.headline: Learned models decode collective motions and conformations of biomolecules
ranked.summary: Preprints and a new published package extend learned and ensemble-based descriptions of biomolecular dynamics to MD, AFM, and coarse-grained data.

ranked.headline: Topology-aware encodings of brain networks for dynamic and individual-level analysis
ranked.summary: Graph-based learning of brain connectivity is shifting toward time-varying, topology-preserving, and formally testable representations.

ranked.headline: Learned and physics-based models advance structure-based binding prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair docking, deep pocket prediction, and ensemble descriptors with physics-based sampling for ligand and degrader targets.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings and transport priors infer cell dynamics and regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics methods now pair neighborhood graphs with optimal transport, morphology, and semantic priors for inference.

ranked.headline: Learned tokenization of protein structure and DNA for efficient long-context models
ranked.summary: Learned tokenizers for protein structure and DNA are now paired with KV-cache compression to scale genomic language models to longer contexts.

ranked.headline: Compressed and alignment-free methods scale microbial genomic and metagenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications couple alignment-free or compressed sequence representations directly with classification and phylogenetic inference.

ranked.headline: Reference-based validation of docking and structure models against MD and structural…
ranked.summary: Docking and structure predictions for ternary, antibody-antigen and protein-protein complexes are now scored against MD or structural references.

ranked.headline: Single-cell readouts link perturbations, morphology, and splicing to functional outcomes
ranked.summary: Perturbation- and splice-resolved single-cell readouts now connect CRISPR screens, miRNA morphology, and immunotherapy response to functional inference.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale mining of bacterial plasmids, genomic islands and secreted effectors
ranked.summary: Large bacterial genome collections now enable systematic mapping of plasmids, defence islands and secreted effectors across hosts and environments.

ranked.headline: Mobility-informed reproduction number estimation and ABC calibration of epidemic models
ranked.summary: Open-source calibration tools and mobility-aware renewal models now support data-driven estimates of epidemic transmission and reproduction numbers.

ranked.headline: Open-source LLM agents translate natural language into genomic and kinetic model queries
ranked.summary: Open-source LLM agents now match or beat GeneGPT on most genomic QA benchmarks, and extend to cohort curation and kinetic model querying.

ranked.headline: Network and kinase models rank candidate genes, kinases, and metabolic pathways
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple network decomposition, dose-response proteomics, and predicted pathway annotations to prioritize biological targets.

ranked.headline: Gradient-based and local learning rules train biophysical and cortical neural models
ranked.summary: Gradient-based fitting of detailed neurons and cortically constrained RNNs now tests learning phenomena from voltage data to conditioning behavior.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and expression models probe plant gene function and seed development
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair candidate-scale maize microprotein discovery with legume ortholog expression modelling and ovule evolution.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models guide design of plasmid manufacturing and biosensor circuits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply genome-scale and circuit-level models to specify plasmid, metabolic, and biosensor configurations for biomanufacturing.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models of drug and radiation dosing bias optimized therapy predictions
ranked.summary: Digital-twin, PBPK, and model-form analyses are being used to optimize ESA, vaccine, and chemo/radiotherapy regimens in silico.
